PAPERS-01; Memorithm/orchestrator#81. Depends on Hub#89 exact integrated f873bc04e996e13c33958702e48e8b1c411f9c11 (2/2 integrated gates,286Rust+12root protocol,66Python,6realrunsc controls). Entire native controls ZIP retained SHA25603d2b15feb6993fc23ade8163a2b86c83faafc06440f5eb07cd48ee1fe9d18a1; workflow verifies byte equality and independent fixedhost512/guest64→128 paired requests/receipts. Legacy wire omission intentionally defaults guest to requested PID budget. Consumer1..4096 validation refuses before workspace/dispatch; added boundary and wire regression tests. Ordinary CI uses locked graph and verified full upstream action SHAs with checkout credentials disabled. No dependency versions changed besides exact owner Git source. Actual consumer live test still required, not replaced by retained observations.

Validation: local diff/shell jq receipt predicates pass; Rust unavailable locally, exact CI rust/audit/live and review must run for candidate 78151131e8c495eec263b0a3676ed387a1a8b5c8 and integrated source before closure. Tests/ABI mocks are not OS or hardware qualification. Mandatory root/offmain/SECURITY policies read, no licence/attribution change or excluded repository mutation. Rust struct addition in owner is optional on JSON, consumer imports guard and keeps its known wire shape.

Remaining: aggregate workspace quota and durable ambiguous-creation/quarantine reconciliation not implemented/qualified. PAPERS-01 remains open. Successful sandbox diagnostics retain zero-fitness/nonempirical authority and scientific freezes/holdouts remain untouched. No automatic host fallback.
